paper_title: Constraining Axion Dark Matter with Big Bang Nucleosynthesis
notes: BBN excluded region (orange, Fig.1 left panel), (g_d,m_a) plane = AxionEDM. Boundary reconstructed analytically from the paper's quoted results rather than digitised, then cross-checked against Fig.1. Relation g_d = 2.4e-16 e*cm / f_a (eq.16); with 1 cm=5.06773e13 GeV^-1 and e set to 1 (natural units, matching the figure's g_d[GeV^-2] axis) this is g_d = 1.216e-2 GeV^-1 / f_a. For m_a>1e-16 eV the numerical BBN bound is f_a m_a = 1.3e-9 GeV^2 (delta Y_p/Y_p=10%), giving boundary g_d = 9.35e-3 * m_a[eV] (slope 1 in log-log). For m_a<1e-16 eV, eq.(15) f_a m_a ~ 1.8e-9 (m_a/1e-16 eV)^{3/4} gives g_d ~ 6.76e-15 * m_a[eV]^{1/4} (slope 1/4); small ~sqrt2 discontinuity at 1e-16 eV is the paper's own approximation matching. Excluded region is g_d ABOVE this line (f_a m_a below threshold = too-strong coupling). Line width in figure reflects ~40% uncertainty in g_d; central line reported. Bound assumes axion is 100% of DM at cosmological mean density (rho_bar_DM=2.7e-27 kg/m^3, eq.10); no free local halo density enters, so dm_density_assumed=null. The 0.3 GeV/cm^3 in eq.16 is only illustrative for the QCD-axion EDM amplitude, not the BBN bound. Confidence 0.95 from the 4He mass-fraction measurement range (95% C.L.). Verified: QCD axion line (f_a m_a=Lambda_QCD^2~6e-3 GeV^2) reproduces black line in Fig.1 (g_d~2e-9 at m_a=1 eV).
